summary: The InsightHub API 5xx ratio exceeded 5% for more than one minute, affecting chat requests.
evidence_source: simulated Prometheus incident data; not live-cluster evidence

top_hypotheses.hypothesis: An upstream dependency timeout caused API requests to fail while the API target itself remained reachable.
A deployment changed provider configuration or timeout behavior for the chat request path.

ruled_out.reason: The API scrape target reported up=1 during the error burst.
The observed 9.6% 5xx rate is 32 times the 0.3% baseline and exceeds the 5% alert threshold.

recommended_actions: Correlate API error-code metadata with generation and embedding provider timeout telemetry; do not expose request content in logs.
Compare the active API deployment revision and provider configuration with the last healthy revision.
Apply the approved timeout or circuit-breaker mitigation and verify the 5xx ratio returns below 5%.
Capture baseline, mitigation, and recovery timestamps as incident evidence before resolving the alert.
